subject: Deployment options and SOC2/BAA next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment options and SOC2/BAA next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the right deployment path for Acme Health.

Summary of what we heard:
- Data type: PHI for a subset of workflows (clinical notes ingestion, patient Q&A).
- Compliance needs: BAA required, SOC2 Type II evidence requested, audit log retention for 7 years, periodic penetration testing reports, and support for customer-managed keys.
- Preference: initial interest in Private VPC/on-prem for full isolation, but open to Dedicated capacity if that meets BAA and logging requirements and provides more predictable pricing. Hosted API is acceptable only for non-PHI workloads.

What Redwood can provide (short):
- BAA: we sign BAAs and have a standard template (attached).
- SOC2: attached our most recent SOC2 Type II attestation (2025).
- Deployment options: Hosted API (no PHI), Dedicated (isolated GPU pools + contractual controls), Private VPC or on-prem package (customer-controlled networking, KMS/HSM integration).
- Security controls: audit logs, retention policies, encryption at rest/in transit, key management integrations, and support for custom retention windows via our Console.

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_Redwood_2025.pdf, Redwood_BAA_Template.docx

Proposed next steps:
1) Share Acme's requirements doc (if you haven't already) so we can map specifics — cc'd Dylan for the technical mapping.
2) Schedule a 45-min technical deep dive with Dylan (solutions) + Neha (security) to walk deployment options, network diagrams, and KMS approach — suggested window: next Tue/Wed.
3) We’ll produce a mutual action plan (timeline, deliverables, rough TCO for Dedicated vs Private) within 3 business days after the technical call.

Please confirm: a) preferred next-call times, b) who from Acme will be the technical/procurement contact, and c) any additional evidence required beyond SOC2 (ISO, penetration tests, etc.).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment options and SOC2/BAA next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: we are leaning toward Private VPC (or on-prem) for any PHI workloads — requirements driven by our security and legal teams.

Specific asks we need to confirm before scheduling procurement:
- Can Redwood support a BAA for Private VPC and Dedicated deployments? (yes/no)
- Do you provide SOC2 Type II attestation and a gap list (areas covered) — we need the attestation and an inventory of controls mapped to our questionnaire.
- Log delivery/retention: we need at-rest archive to our S3 for 7 years and the ability to export audit logs regularly.
- Key management: confirm support for customer-managed KMS/HSM and whether keys can be rotated without service downtime.

I've attached our internal requirements matrix (Acme_MA_Requirements_20260228.pdf). If you can answer the bullets above and propose times for next week, we’ll loop in our infra/security and procurement folks.

Best,
Emma
Director of Product, Acme Health
emma.clark@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_MA_Requirements_20260228.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment options and SOC2/BAA next steps

Thanks Emma — great questions. Short answers below and proposed plan. Full details in the technical call (Dylan + Neha to run).

- BAA: Yes — we sign BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments. We’ll send the signed BAA and can adjust terms for data residency and retention (see attached Redwood_BAA_Template.docx).
- SOC2: Attached is our SOC2 Type II attestation (2025). We can also provide a controls matrix mapping our SOC2 controls to common questionnaires; if helpful, Dylan can prepare a short mapping to your matrix before the call.
- Logs/retention: We support delivery of audit logs to customer-owned S3 for Dedicated and Private deployments; retention policies can be configured to meet 7-year requirements. For Hosted API we do not permit PHI and log delivery to customer S3 is limited.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys are supported for Private VPC and our on-prem offering. Key rotation is handled with zero-downtime key rolling for active sessions; we’ll walk through specifics in the technical call.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (45 min) — purpose: network diagram, key mgmt approach, log export flow, and scoping for procurement. Proposed times: Thu 3/5 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 3/6 09:00–09:45 PT. Please confirm which works for Acme.
2) After the call: Redwood will deliver a mutual action plan with timelines, a high-level TCO for Dedicated vs Private, and a draft SOW/Work Order for procurement.
3) Procurement: please share the contact who will own the PO/SOW. Dylan — can you prepare a brief control mapping and an estimated monthly cost range for Dedicated vs Private (ballpark only) once Acme confirms expected qps and dataset size?

I’ve attached our SOC2 attestation again and the BAA template.

—
